ablation.verdict: The retriever alone wins at 0.8920. The language model does not earn its 4,036 forward passes: on its own it scores 0.6040, and fusing it in reaches 0.8920. Ship the retriever.

distillation.verdict: The multinomial logistic regression (29,645 params) reaches 0.8820 against the teacher's 0.8920 - 98.9% of the teacher's accuracy, -0.0100. Whether that trade is worth taking is a cost question, not an accuracy question; see src/cost.py.

cheapest_automated.note: The ratio is enormous because the automated options cost a fraction of a cent per 1,000 items - compute is essentially free at this scale. The real trade is therefore ACCURACY, not cost, which is why the gated option exists: it buys back precision with human review and is the only automated option that is not dominated on quality.
